description: This Kotlin source file defines the ReflectionDiffer object, which uses Kotlin reflection and kotlinx.serialization to implement JSON Merge Patch (RFC 7386) for data classes. It provides functions to apply JSON diffs to data class instances, construct new objects from JSON, and handle specific types like LocalizedTextV2 and LocalizedFileV2.

classes.name: ReflectionDiffer
classes.description: An object providing functions to apply JSON diffs to Kotlin data class instances using reflection, including constructing objects from JSON and applying specific type diffs.

methods.name: applyDiff
methods.description: Applies a JSON diff to an existing data class object, updating its properties accordingly.

methods.name: constructFromJson
methods.description: Constructs a new object of type T from a JSON diff, used when a new object is introduced.

methods.name: diffMap
methods.description: Handles diff application for specific map types like LocalizedTextV2 and LocalizedFileV2.

methods.name: applyTextDiff
methods.description: Applies a diff to a LocalizedTextV2 object.

methods.name: applyFileDiff
methods.description: Applies a diff to a LocalizedFileV2 object.

methods.name: applyMapTextDiff
methods.description: Applies a diff to a map of LocalizedTextV2 objects.

methods.name: primitiveOrNull
methods.description: Extension function to safely get a JsonPrimitive from a JsonElement.

methods.name: jsonArrayOrNull
methods.description: Extension function to safely get a JsonArray from a JsonElement.

methods.name: jsonObjectOrNull
methods.description: Extension function to safely get a JsonObject from a JsonElement.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Helper function to throw a SerializationException with a message.

methods.name: decodeOr
methods.description: Decodes a JSON object key into a specified type, or returns a default value if key is absent.
